title: Block Hours of an Onsite Service Visit on TimeBank Prepaid Service Hours
content:
## Which visit is figured

The visit figured is the one on the client's ticket most recently resolved to the prepaid-block route with onsite labor, its date being that resolution's date, as the ClearPath Managed IT Services ticket history records it. Every service visit is priced from its own ticket's records alone. Resolutions are stamped to the minute; where a business-hours and an after-hours onsite resolution carry the same minute the after-hours one counts as more recent, where two onsite resolutions of one class carry the same minute the one with more billable minutes counts as more recent, and where they also record the same billable minutes the one on the higher ticket number counts as more recent; a ticket is resolved once, so the ticket number ends every tie.

The visit is a service visit unless its ticket was opened in the service request category on or after the delivery date of the client's most recently delivered Hardware Procurement order, meaning the latest delivery date among the client's orders whose status is delivered, and no more than 14 calendar days after it, counting the delivery date as day 0, which makes it an installation visit drawn under the installation rule. When the client has no onsite resolution routed to the block, when the visit is an installation visit, or when the block's ledger already carries an onsite-support draw for that ticket, no service visit is figured.

## Block hours

The visit's minutes are the billable minutes the ticket's resolution records. A service visit of TimeBank Prepaid Service Hours draws those minutes, rounded up to the size's billing increment and never fewer than the size's onsite minimum, divided by 60, at the size's technician ratio and with a multiplier of 1, rounded half up to the hundredth of an hour. The minutes drawn are settled first and the block hours are taken from them; the block hours are rounded once, at the end.

## Worked cases (hypothetical resolutions on a TimeBank 40-Hour Block: 15-minute increment, 60-minute onsite minimum, technician ratio 1.0)

| Billable minutes | Minutes drawn | Block hours |
|---|---|---|
| 100 | 105 | 1.75 |
| 40 | 60 (onsite minimum) | 1.00 |
| 125 | 135 | 2.25 |

Delivery-window cases: a service request ticket opened on the delivery date (day 0) or 14 days later is an installation visit; one opened 15 days later, or opened in another category, is a service visit.
